lead.t: Definition: Distinctive chronic inflammatory reaction from acquired defects in phagocyte function; arises in setting of chronic bacterial infection (mostly E. coli, occasionally Proteus); increased frequency in immunosuppressed (e.g., renal transplant recipients).
lead.s: Lower Urinary Tract & Ureter Pathology: Obstruction & Tumors — Notes
